description.zh: 样本ID前缀，包含数字、字母和下划线。
description.en: The prefix of the sample ID. The prefix can contain digits, letters, and underscores.

description.zh: 自定义标签，最多支持10个标签，多个标签以英文逗号（,）分割。
description.en: The custom labels. A maximum of 10 labels are supported. Separate multiple labels with commas (,).

description.zh: 每页最多显示的样本数目，取值范围1~200。
description.en: The maximum number of samples to display per page. Valid values: 1 to 200.
The starting record. Valid values: 0 to 2000.

description.zh: 排列方式。包括asc（升序）和desc（降序）。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:
- asc: ascending order
- desc: descending order.

description.zh: 当查询结果超过2000条时，需要使用上一次请求返回的Token作为请求下一页的参数。
description.en: When the query result exceeds 2,000 records, use the Token returned from the previous request as a parameter to query the next page.

1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。

><notice>
本能力支持企业或个人认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
></notice>

3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。

- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 限制说明
查询人脸样本列表接口提交任务并发默认为2QPS。

## 计费说明
查询人脸样本列表能力可免费调用。
descriptions.en:
## Description
The ListFaceEntities operation queries the list of face samples in a face database.

> - You can join the Chinese-language DingTalk group (ID 23109592) to contact us for technical support regarding the China site (Chinese).
- For Chinese-language help with Alibaba Cloud Vision AI API integration, usage, or consultation, contact us through the Chinese-language DingTalk group (23109592).

## Getting started
1. Create an Alibaba Cloud account: Open the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.alibabacloud.com), click **China Site Account Registration** in the upper-right corner, and complete the account registration as prompted.
2. Activate the service: Make sure you have activated [Face and Body Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).
><notice>
This feature is available to enterprise users or users who have completed verify your identity - Individual account. For more information about identity verification, see [Real-name verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
></notice>

3. Create an AccessKey pair: Make sure you have [created an AccessKey pair](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey pair, grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/ListFaceEntities?lang=JAVA) to debug this operation online, view complete sample code, and obtain SDK dependency information. You can also download the complete project.
5. Integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use from [SDK overview](~~145033~~).
- Find and install the SDK package for the Face and Body (facebody) category in the corresponding SDK documentation.
- Modify the sample code provided in the References as needed and invoke the operation.

6. Direct client calls: Common client call methods for this feature include the following:
- [Direct call from web frontend](~~467779~~)
- [Direct call from mini programs](~~467780~~)
- [Direct call from Android](~~467781~~)
- [Direct call from iOS](~~467782~~).

## Limits
The default concurrency for submitting tasks through the ListFaceEntities operation is 2 QPS.

## Billing
The ListFaceEntities operation is free of charge.
